root: ^Welcome, traveler. These hills remember every life you have lived.

c-0: ^Three trials hold the northern gate: a wandering spider, a trapped chest, and a stone switch. Clear them to face the Giant Spider.
c-1: ^Beyond the guardian lie five chests. Choose one. What you claim is yours, even if your next expedition ends badly.
c-2: ^Then keep a potion close, and let no haste outrun your judgment.
c-3: ^A new life restores your youth and lets you choose another talent. Your skills, AP, possessions, and lifetime progress endure.
c-4: ^May the road lead you safely home.
